page.layout: One column of running text. Running head "AD INDOS." with page number 145 at the top right. Below the text, at the foot: signature "K" at the left and catchword "Sic" at the right.

main_text.p: culcat, qui in furore suo occiderunt virum à Deo datum & voluntate sua prava eradicaverunt murum civitatis Sanctæ, idcirco inquit, in secretum eorum non eas anima mea, & in coetu eorum non uniatur gloria mea:id est tu qui verus es Israel, ne consentias pravis illorum conatibus, & vos qui estis propter splendorem sanctitatis vestræ gloria feminis[?] mei, ne conjungamini eis.

Dispergendis vero decem tribubus colle-ctionem annuntiat, quodque possessores suos tandem possessuri sint indicat: de qua ipsorum victoria illum in benedictione Dan agere, indicat satis suspirium illud, indiciumque animi consideratione futurorum commoti, dum addit, salutem tuam expecto ô Domine: ex quo colligere possumus, id quod dixerat; Dan erit ut serpens juxta viam, ut cerastes juxta semitam, mordens calcaneos equi, & cadet sessor ejus retrorsum; spiritualiter intelligendum esse de præconibus Evangelij prudentissimis, qui ex hac tribu, in ultima illorum conversione exurgent: qui equum, seu falsum Antichristi doctorem, ita vulnerabunt, ut sessor ejus, seu populus qui ejus doctrina vehitur, retrorsum cadat & ab illo deficiat.

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. "feminis" is uncertain: the initial letter could be long s, giving "seminis"; marked [?]. "mea:id" is printed with a colon and is kept as printed. Signature "K" and catchword "Sic" are at the foot and kept out of the text.
